<!-- pr-reviewer: 03a6d05ade6673bd5fa2b7eaecc0a23af4f9c35f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (one note: screenshots owed, see below).

**What looks good**
- Display only, verified in the diff: the new `setup_display.rs` is read only by `toolpath_lines`, the gizmo list, `collect_parts`, `hidden_in_view` (viewport pick filter) and the browser row. Posting, simulation and collision code never read `shown_setups`.
- Storage matches the other browser eyes (`hidden_models`, `hidden_stocks`, `hidden_offsets`, `hidden_paths`): `State` field, not saved, not undoable, cleared on New/Open. That is the "ephemeral UI state" carve-out, and `docs/decisions/1494-setup-eye.md` records it, so no command or MCP tool is consistent.
- The two edited gizmo tests (`law_tests.rs`, `wcs_gizmo_tests.rs`) only add the eye toggle: the assertions that another setup's triad is drawn, and where, are unchanged. Nothing guarded was weakened, and the new default-hidden case is pinned in `setup_eye.rs`.
- `hiding_a_setup_never_changes_what_posts` pins the posted op list with the eye on and off.
- ui -> app layering holds; no PNG snapshots touched; structural row assertions present; no new dependency or process file.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner, main df90b031: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43497235884)
- Quick gate: ui suites ok, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- No `cfg(windows)` lines added, so no local re-run.

**Requested before merge**
- None blocking. The PR body already says before/after screenshots are owed (`ui-prs-need-screenshots`); add them before /merge-ready offers it.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `state.rs` (4436 lines) and `interact.rs` (1754) were already far over 400 lines; they grow by a few lines. The new code sits in its own small file.
- `mod setup_display;` in `lib.rs` is not in alphabetical position. Cosmetic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
